root_cause: The Required website lane swept every sitemap route at three viewports sequentially. With 92 public routes this meant 276 serial browser navigations, causing otherwise-green PRs to spend minutes in the same visibility step and accumulate concurrent GitHub runners.
prevention_rule: Keep full public-route and three-viewport coverage, but execute route checks with bounded concurrency and retain the global fail-closed time budget.

evidence.blocked_step: Verify all public pages are visibly rendered
